firstStageCounterbalancedComparison.boundary: Twelve fixed adjacent original/candidate pairs in one process, order alternated, sixteen complete prepared public Resize operations per subject; all pairs retained without filtering. Each isolated assembly owns an identical borrowed resident source and prepared plan. Setup/JIT/validation excluded; source reads, row reset, independent result allocation and disposal included. Diagnostic comparison of managed builds, not new FFmpeg cost or parity proof.

codegenFinding: Actual production FullOpts listings confirm closed double kernels and no runtime type dispatch. First stage uses256-bit conversions per pixel; second restores512-bit pair conversions and uses256 only for tails. Code size and instruction differences are not measured phase costs or a causal attribution of slowdown.
decision: Reject both implementations. First stage has confirmed5.07%/195.89us paired word-enlargement regression. Revised stage passes exactness and typed pair codegen, but its two short complete workloads show no useful lead; no second-stage independent confirmation or favorable resampling. Keep the original row conversion. This does not permanently close future streaming designs.
